title: Summary of the book of John - Chapter 1 || Biblia Tafsiri Mbalimbali
description:
Discover the majesty of Jesus Christ in John chapter one, where the eternal Word becomes flesh to dwell among us. Join us as we explore the testimony of John the Baptist and the life-changing invitation to come and see the Lamb of God. Learn three practical ways to walk in His marvelous light today.
